role: Interface for objects re-run on every resource reload: the texture manager, the language manager and the grass/foliage colour listeners register themselves.
notes: The colour-listener implementors have their own records (FoliageColorReloadListener, GrassColorReloadListener) because the buffers they fill are consumed by the native mesher. idxaudit 2026-09-27: scope reason rewritten.
scope_reason: Reload-listener interface; the colour listeners that implement it have their own records, and native has no reload.
